rationale.threshold_status: Engineering safeguards, not label-tuned probabilities. GK support 0.35/0.15 requires torso/shorts agreement; 10 of 30 and 3 weak geometry observations must accompany it.
rationale.staff: No trustworthy technical-area/pitch-motion producer is available in these cached data. STAFF is supported by the API but abstains on this run; spectators/bench appearances are not automatically staff.
rationale.other: Require 10 consecutive well-resolved, textured, non-grass, nonmatching observations. Previously observed known uniforms block OTHER and GK relabels on that track. Weak known colors and orange/green searches remain UNKNOWN. Confirmed OTHER cannot automatically become player or GK on the same uninterrupted track.
rationale.goal_context: Hough goal geometry is weak and can match field lines/ads. It is combined with persistent kit and shorts evidence; live/replay state and person identity remain unverified. No hard-coded match frame, track ID, or manually mapped pitch region is used.
rationale.retention: After establishment, a GK retains role without new goal hints while fresh compatible color continues. Scene/frame discontinuity, ID change, large gap or contradictory appearance requires renewed evidence.
